content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 69 vacancies are available - 21 for Professor, 5 for Additional Professor, 17 for Associate Professor, 25 for Assistant Professor, and 1 for Associate Professor (Reader) College of Nursing.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Professor: MD/ MS/ M.Ch/ D.M/ MDS with 11-14 years teaching/ research experience. Additional Professor: MD/ MS/ M.Ch/ D.M/ MDS with 7-10 years teaching/ research experience. Associate Professor: MD/ MS/ M.Ch/ D.M/ MDS with 3-6 years teaching/ research experience. Assistant Professor: MD/ MS/ M.Ch/ D.M/ MDS with 0-3 years teaching/ research experience. Associate Professor (Reader) College of Nursing: M.Sc Nursing with 8 years experience including 5 years teaching.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 58 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: SC/ ST - 5 years, OBC - 3 years, PwD - 10 years (15 for SC/ ST, 13 for OBC), Govt Servant/ Ex-Servicemen - 5 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 is 15th October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 69 vacancies for Medical Faculty and Nursing Faculty positions in the AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 58 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the faculty positions?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications include MBBS/MD/MS/M.Ch/DM/MDS/M.Sc Nursing/PhD, along with relevant teaching and research experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Professor post is as per Level-12, ranging from Rs. 1,01,500 to Rs. 1,67,400 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates. The fee is applicable only for General/OBC categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Can Government servants apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, Government servants can apply, and they are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years.
